name: Small and mid-scale modular LNG
principle: Packaged liquefaction trains of tens to hundreds of tonnes per day make LNG from pipeline gas or small fields for trucks, ships and remote power. Nitrogen expander cycles are favoured for simplicity and turndown; methane expansion and single mixed refrigerant cycles are alternatives.

process_steps.name: Liquefaction (N2 expander, methane expander or SMR)

suppliers.name: Honeywell UOP
suppliers.product: AP-N nitrogen expander, AP-C1, AP-SMR processes (document hosted by UOP)

performance.basis: AP-N single expander 140 to 250 t/d, dual expander 200 to 650 t/d, AP-C1 60 to 800+ t/d

source.note: Honeywell UOP, small-scale LNG liquefaction plant capabilities, March 2025
